speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID).

I have noted your 17-year-old age, the 5-day history of severe abdominal pain, vomiting, and your recent burning pain during intercourse. Given your report of inconsistent condom use with a male partner, these findings strongly suggest a sexually transmitted infection that has ascended to your upper reproductive tract. I will now request a urine culture and a pelvic examination to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes like a ruptured appendicitis.
